description: Shipping costs and transport options. With the order reference and no weight_kg or products it prices the order's cart and its shipping country; otherwise give weight_kg or products (ids with quantities in packages). country: the two-letter destination (default the cart's shipping country, else the storefront country). The answer lists every method with its price in EUR and the storefront currency (destination VAT included), the weight band and the cheapest method, plus transport: the ways to bring the cost down. Pickup at the warehouse in Apeldoorn (NL) is free and is chosen in set_checkout; the shopper's own carrier may collect there; an order can ship at the Dutch rate to an address in the Netherlands, such as a forwarder. Outside NL, BE and DE a custom transport arrangement often costs far less than the standard rate: freight marketplaces (uShip and similar), last-minute capacity offers from carriers, consolidated freight. Compare such options for the shopper when it helps; the store's chat on the website quotes and arranges custom transport. With the order reference (Authorization: Bearer mo1_… or ref) it uses the order; without it, it works for anyone (search: by meaning for the first searches per 10 minutes, then by words only; at most 30 searches per 10 minutes).

country.description: Two-letter destination country, e.g. DE, FR, US; default the cart shipping country, else the storefront country

products.description: Products to ship (instead of weight_kg or the cart): ids with quantities in packages, at most 100

ref.description: Order reference (mo1_…) from start_order, only when the client cannot send it as Authorization: Bearer; with it the search is complete and counts for the order

weight_kg.description: Total weight in kg, when known
